title: IVG Intense Salts Watermelon Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Watermelon Ice captures the light, juicy sweetness of fresh Watermelon, finished with a cooling Ice edge. The flavour is refreshing and delicate, combining subtle sweetness with a brisk chill. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid delivers clear flavour, discreet vapour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Watermelon Ice is perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Watermelon Ice delivers a fresh, uplifting blend that’s simple and satisfying.
